title: Furnace Helper
body:
# 🔥 Furnace Helper 🔥
**Stop babysitting your ovens! Get back to adventuring! 🏃‍♂️💨**

**Have you ever sat there staring at a Smoker like a hungry wolf, waiting for that steak to finish? 🥩 Smelter’s Helper is here to save your time and your sanity! This is a lightweight, client-side mod that turns you into a professional furnace manager. 👨‍🔬📊**

## ✨ What’s Inside ✨
- 🕒 Real-Time Prediction: Our "big brain" algorithm calculates exactly when your items will be ready. 🧠✨

- 🍖 Triple Threat Support: Works perfectly with:

1. Furnaces (The Classic 🪵)

2. Smokers (For the Chefs 🍗)

3. Blast Furnaces (For the Grinders 💎)

**🛠️ Seamless Integration: Just open the GUI once, and the mod handles the rest. Close it and walk away — the helper has your back! 🤝**

**🚀 Zero Lag: Super optimized code. Your FPS stays high, while your ores stay smelting. 📈**

## 🛠 How to Use 🛠
1. Open your furnace/smoker. 🚪
2. Check the status. ✅
3. Run away! Go mine, build, or fight creepers. 🏹
4. Know exactly when it’s DONE without ever coming back to check. 🏁

## 💎 Info 💎
🌍 Server Compatible: Works on any server! You don't need to ask the admin to install anything. It's your little secret. 🤫
⚙️ Client-Side Only: Lightweight and easy to install. Just drop it in your mods folder and go! 📂
Happy Smelting! 🌋 Try not to burn the house down! 🏠🔥

## 📦 How to Install 📦
1. Downlload Fabric 1.21.1
2. Download Fabric API 1.21.1
3. Download the Mod
4. Put these .jar files into your mods folder
5. Enjoy smelting!
